question: A sum of Rs. 3500 is lent out at simple interest in two parts. One part at the annual rate of 7 percent and another part at the annual rate of 5 percent. If the total annual interest is Rs. 210, then what is the sum lent out at the rate of 7 percent?
solution: Given A sum of Rs.3500 is lent in two parts in such a way that the first part is at 7% and the second at 5% per annum. If the total interest received after two years is 440.
